title: Italian basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Italian (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/it/rank.py), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out. Each word has one short everyday sentence in standard Italian as it is spoken in Italy, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
